SourceDocuments._comment: RenderHelperPath is this worker's own executable; pages are rasterized in a child process it starts per invocation, never in the service (DOC-014). RenderWorkRoot is a private folder ACL'd to the worker account.

Ocr._approvedHashes: OCR-017. The SHA-256 the reviewer approved for each installed artifact, copied from the emc-artifact-manifest/1 file the bundle was exported with (scripts/deploy/Set-EmcOcrWorkerConfig.ps1 does the copying). The worker hashes every installed file at start and refuses to run on a mismatch or an empty list.

Logging._comment: Identifiers, counts, durations and categories only; never a word an engine read, never a filename. Under the Service Control Manager the host also writes to the Application event log (source EmcOcrWorker).
